- The same run also reports **seven source-policy hits** on unchanged, retained upstream rusqlite capture sources under `docs/evidence/ci-83bf3914-20261116`. Those remain **unresolved**, and this PR neither hides them nor alters their paths/bytes, the scanner, allow lists, baseline or thresholds.
